summary: Shilling is a Portuguese early-stage firm backed by more than 35 founder limited partners. Its homepage states a typical investment of €100,000 to €1,000,000, a founders fund that shares profits with portfolio founders, and a community platform. The Pitch page says Shilling was the first institutional investor in companies that later raised more than €200,000,000 and that it looks for tech-driven ideas and well-balanced teams. Stage, sector, geography and a street address are not stated on the pages reviewed.

investmentEvidence.fact: Founder Ricardo Vice Santos is quoted on the homepage as a founder LP; the site also lists portfolio insights such as Luca and Vitaance. Rounds and dates are not stated on the homepage.

sources.title: Homepage: typical investment size, founders fund and community
Pitch to us: first-institutional-investor positioning and pitch form
